title: assessment-monitoring
description: Prove assessment persistence, uncertainty, feedback and frozen exports through the production gateway. Seed only an isolated validation home first; rerun after restarting it.

gateway-proof.intent: Read real RPC history and verify all terminal states, uncertainty, feedback persistence and inconclusive evaluation without references.

browser-proof.intent: Open the real assessment detail, type feedback with CDP and confirm its persisted revision through assessment.get. Requires isolated CDP and UI URLs; dismiss the first-launch welcome modal before running.

pagination-proof.intent: Verify draft identity survives a newer RPC record, then save two feedback questions on a loaded older page. Seed --pagination before startup.

restart-proof.intent: Own and restart a separate gateway process on FARMSLOT_ASSESSMENT_RESTART_PORT, proving persisted feedback/report and interrupted attempts.

screenshot.intent: Capture the actual isolated assessment UI after real gateway actions.
